strings.name: Warren Buffett
strings.role: Investor · Long-time leader of Berkshire Hathaway
strings.summary: Warren Buffett is known for value investing and long-term capital allocation. After gaining control of Berkshire Hathaway in 1965, he gradually transformed a textile company into a diversified group. His investing approach emphasizes business fundamentals, management and a margin of safety. He has also supported philanthropy through stock donations and the Giving Pledge. Berkshire completed its CEO succession at the start of 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected milestones in entrepreneurship, investing and philanthropy, with the CEO transition verified through January 2026. Does not provide live job titles, wealth rankings or investment advice.

strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: Transforming Berkshire Hathaway
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: After gaining control in 1965, consistently allocated capital to insurance and other businesses.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: Long-term value investing
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Combined quantitative valuation with business quality and management considerations in a widely recognized investing practice.
strings.highlights.highlight-03.title: Philanthropic commitments
strings.highlights.highlight-03.text: Pledged gradual stock donations in 2006 and helped establish the Giving Pledge in 2010.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Completes the CEO transition
strings.timeline.event-01.text: Greg Abel succeeded him as Berkshire CEO, ending Buffett’s long tenure in the role.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Helps launch the Giving Pledge
strings.timeline.event-02.text: Joined Bill and Melinda Gates in encouraging wealthy people to pledge most of their wealth to philanthropy.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: Pledges gradual stock donations
strings.timeline.event-03.text: Committed to donating Berkshire shares in installments to several charitable foundations.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: Closes his original investment partnership
strings.timeline.event-04.text: Liquidated the partnership, offering investors options including withdrawal or continued ownership of Berkshire shares.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Gains control of Berkshire Hathaway
strings.timeline.event-05.text: After taking over the textile business, gradually redirected capital into other operations and investments.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Establishes an investment partnership
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Returned to Omaha and began managing investments funded by limited partners including friends and relatives.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Joins Graham’s company
strings.timeline.event-07.text: Worked at Graham-Newman, deepening his practical experience in value investing.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Completes his studies at Columbia
strings.timeline.event-08.text: Earned a master’s degree after studying with Benjamin Graham.
strings.timeline.event-09.title: Born in Omaha
strings.timeline.event-09.text: Grew up in the United States and gained early business experience delivering newspapers and running other small ventures.
